purpose: Privacy-safe analytics event catalog for agent-readiness and AI-discoverability monitoring.

events.name: contact_click
events.privacy: Does not collect personal message content.

events.name: form_submit_attempt
events.purpose: Track form submit attempts by form id.
events.privacy: Does not collect form field values.

events.name: mcp_tool_call
events.privacy: Logs tool name, route, request id, and timestamp only.

events.name: mcp_resource_read
events.privacy: Logs resource id and timestamp only.

events.name: inquiry_preparation
events.privacy: Does not collect RFQ content or personal fields.

events.name: agent_concierge_question
events.purpose: Measure deterministic agent-concierge use and identify unanswered public questions for owner knowledge review.
events.privacy: Answered questions log metadata and a normalized fingerprint only. A new unanswered question is logged once after email, phone, credential, token, and control-character redaction. Source IP addresses are not written to application logs.

events.name: public_discovery_read
events.purpose: Track reads of llms, OpenAPI, data, and well-known discovery files via Vercel/CDN logs.
events.privacy: Use aggregate path and user-agent analysis. Do not store personal data.
